SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, min(fiscal_week) AS wk_min, max(fiscal_week) AS wk_max, min(calendar_date) AS d_min, max(calendar_date) AS d_max, count(*) AS n_days, count(DISTINCT fiscal_week) AS n_weeks
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
regional AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM regional ty
JOIN regional ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_year) AS fy, COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) AS store_id, m.net_sales, c.ctl_sales, m.net_sales - c.ctl_sales AS diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year = m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id = m.store_id
WHERE abs(COALESCE(m.net_sales,0) - COALESCE(c.ctl_sales,0)) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH q AS (
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND is_trading_day
),
st AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_id < 900
),
act AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE receipts > 0
)
SELECT q.fiscal_year, st.store_id, c.store_name, c.region, c.open_date, c.close_date, count(*) AS missing_trading_days, min(q.calendar_date) AS first_missing, max(q.calendar_date) AS last_missing
FROM q CROSS JOIN st
JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.is_current
LEFT JOIN act a ON a.business_date = q.calendar_date AND a.store_id = st.store_id
WHERE a.store_id IS NULL
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
